sources.title: TVS Motor Company overview
sources.text: TVS Motor Company manufactures two-wheelers and three-wheelers for Indian and international markets. Its products include motorcycles, scooters and mopeds. The company operates manufacturing facilities in India and Indonesia.

sources.title: Bajaj Motors Limited — company profile
sources.verification: Company-published LinkedIn profile; exact identity confirmed by user and independently checked against the public profile.
sources.text: Bajaj Motors Limited was formed in 1986. The company manufactures machined components, assembled components, forging components and casting components. It serves markets for two-wheelers, four-wheelers, tractors and heavy equipment. Its business serves domestic and export markets.
